## Description

Records gains a Trackers tab: the patient's BP and fasting sugar log (patient-reported observations the doctor sees on the chart, labelled as patient reported), a managed child's growth curve, next vaccine and milestone questions, and a cycle tracker (period days, predicted next period and fertile days as estimates, averages, log a period or symptoms). Cycle data is private to the patient: never visible to family members or proxies, and shared with the doctor only when she opts in; pregnancy pauses it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A reading logged in the app shows on the chart's trend as patient reported.
- [ ] **AC2.** A proxy or family member never sees another person's cycle data (server test, mutation checked).
- [ ] **AC3.** Sharing cycle history with the clinic is an explicit opt-in the patient can withdraw.
- [ ] **AC4.** Predictions carry the "estimate, not contraception or a diagnosis" text.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
